title: Enterprise Connectivity: service restoration
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs service restoration for service restoration.

## Policy clause 1
The contract status is suspended.

## Policy clause 2
The contract payment restriction is clear.

## Policy clause 3
Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance.

## Policy clause 4
Set status active.

## Policy clause 5
Bill restoration fee under lifecycle fee rules only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history.

## Policy clause 6
A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Evidence condition 1
For service restoration, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The contract status is suspended. The evidence consists of contract identifier, status. Correlate the same contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Evidence condition 2
For service restoration, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: The contract payment restriction is clear. The evidence consists of contract identifier, payment restriction. Correlate the same contract identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Points of judgement
A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the restoration fee used by this rule.

## Record identity: service restoration
The agent moves the contract from suspended to active. One persistent contract per signed resource scope.
